transcript.title: Weekly round-up
transcript.text: Hello, I'm Nova, the Ventryx AI presenter. This is your weekly market round-up for the week ending Friday 30 October.

transcript.title: Markets this week
transcript.text: Here's how the markets closed the week. The S&P 500 finished down 0.6 per cent. The tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 was down 2.0 per cent, and here in London the FTSE 100 ended up 0.4 per cent. Bitcoin was down 2.6 per cent over seven days.

transcript.title: Biggest movers
transcript.text: Among the hundred big US stocks we track, the top riser was General Motors, up 15.1 per cent, followed by Eli Lilly and and KLA. At the other end, ServiceNow fell 33.9 per cent, with Intel and Marvell Technology also lower.

transcript.title: In the headlines
transcript.text: In the news on General Motors, Yahoo Finance ran the headline: Ford, General Motors stocks had this in common for week ending Oct. 30.

transcript.title: In the headlines
transcript.text: In the news on ServiceNow, Yahoo Finance ran the headline: Why the 27% Crash in ServiceNow's Stock Looks Like a Golden Opportunity.

transcript.title: Momentum top 5
transcript.text: On the Ventryx momentum list, this month's five are Micron Technology, Dell, Advanced Micro Devices, Intel and Marvell Technology. All five are holding their places for now. The next swap is on Monday 30 November.

transcript.title: Crypto top 5
transcript.text: In crypto, our experimental top five are NEAR Protocol, Zcash, Arbitrum, Uniswap and Monero, with Bitcoin 6 per cent above its two-hundred-day average.

transcript.title: Next week
transcript.text: Looking ahead to the week of Monday 2 November. Results are due from Apple and Palantir on Monday; Advanced Micro Devices on Tuesday. And on the prediction market Polymarket, the question "Will the price of Bitcoin be above $78,000 on November 1?" is trading at about 55 per cent yes.

transcript.title: That's the week
transcript.text: That's your round-up. Remember, this is research, not financial advice. I'm Nova. See you next Sunday.
